name: claude-mods
description: Small Claude Code mods: session card, prompt index, plugin toggles, flow board, pendings band, Haiku search routing

plugins.name: flow-board
plugins.description: One line above the prompt: background agents, git dirty/ahead, PR checks, GSD state and whether /clear is safe. Adds /park and a one-press GSD phase handoff button.

plugins.name: haiku-search
plugins.description: Push main-thread search to Explore on Haiku; routes subagent models (model-router)

plugins.name: npm-block
plugins.description: Rewrites npm to pnpm in Bash commands instead of blocking them

plugins.name: pendings-band
plugins.description: One line above the prompt with the next ready pending for the project you are in, read from a local goal ledger (bundled goals.py). Read only.

plugins.name: prompt-index
plugins.description: A pane listing your prompts; Enter scrolls the chat to that prompt

plugins.name: secret-mask
plugins.description: Masks secrets in tool results, hook context and attachments before the model or transcript sees them

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: One calm card above the prompt: what this session is about, whose turn it is, what is pending and the next step

plugins.name: toggles
plugins.description: Pane to turn plugins, skills and MCP servers on or off for this project
